_doc: Data-driven achievements. Each is one condition evaluated over lifetime save stats + the just-ended run's stats (game.gd:_check_achievements). type -> field: total_kills/elite_kills/nights_survived/deaths/evolutions_total/heroes_count read the lifetime tally; run_kills/run_level read the ended run; no_hit_win = victory taking zero hits; stage_cleared/ending match an id. Purely additive: unknown types never crash (fail-soft).
